routes.label: Find the time for one task

question: Marie does three equally time-consuming tasks in a row without taking breaks. She begins the first task at \(1{:}00\) PM and finishes the second task at \(2{:}40\) PM. When does she finish the third task?
solution:
From \(1{:}00\) PM to \(2{:}40\) PM is \(1\) hour \(40\) minutes, or \(100\) minutes. Because the first two tasks take equal amounts of time and there are no breaks, each task takes
\[
100\div2=50\text{ minutes}.
\]
The third task therefore finishes \(50\) minutes after \(2{:}40\) PM, at \(\boxed{3{:}30\text{ PM}}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{B}}\).
